# targets

Scan targets (hosts, port lists), OCI image and web application targets.

- Toolset name: `targets`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 18 (6 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_oci_image_target`

**Create OCI image target** · mutating

Create an OCI image target from one or more image references (e.g. `registry.example/app:1.2`). Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `credential_id` | string | no | UUID of a registry credential |
| `image_references` | array<string> | yes | Image references, e.g. "registry.example/app:1.2" (at least one) |
| `name` | string | yes | Target name |

### `openvas_create_target`

**Create target** · mutating

Create a scan target from host entries. Not idempotent: repeating the call creates duplicates (the gateway rejects duplicate names with 400).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alive_test` | string | no | Alive test method. One of: "Scan Config Default", "ICMP Ping", "TCP-ACK Service Ping", "TCP-SYN Service Ping", "ARP Ping", "ICMP, TCP-ACK Service Ping", "ICMP, ARP Ping", "TCP-ACK Service, ARP Ping", "ICMP, TCP-ACK Service, ARP Ping", "Consider Alive" |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `esxi_credential_id` | string | no | ESXi credential UUID for authenticated scans |
| `exclude_hosts` | array<string> | no | Hosts to exclude from scans |
| `hosts` | array<string> | yes | Host entries: IPs, CIDR ranges, hostnames |
| `name` | string | yes | Target name |
| `port_list_id` | string | no | UUID of the port list to scan (gvmd requires one before a task can run; see openvas_list_port_lists) |
| `reverse_lookup_only` | boolean | no | Only scan hosts that resolve via reverse lookup |
| `reverse_lookup_unify` | boolean | no | Deduplicate hosts that reverse-resolve to the same name |
| `smb_credential_id` | string | no | SMB credential UUID for authenticated scans |
| `snmp_credential_id` | string | no | SNMP credential UUID for authenticated scans |
| `ssh_credential_id` | string | no | SSH credential UUID for authenticated scans |

### `openvas_create_web_application_target`

**Create web application target** · mutating

Create a web application target from one or more URLs. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `credential_id` | string | no | UUID of a credential for authenticated crawling |
| `exclude_urls` | array<string> | no | URLs excluded from crawling |
| `name` | string | yes | Target name |
| `urls` | array<string> | yes | Start URLs, e.g. "https://shop.example" (at least one) |

### `openvas_delete_oci_image_target`

**Delete OCI image target** · destructive

Delete an OCI image target (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_delete_target`

**Delete target** · destructive

Delete a scan target (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a task still uses the target.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_list_oci_image_targets`

**List OCI image targets** · read-only

List OCI (container) image targets. `trash` lists trashed ones.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
| `trash` | boolean | no | List trashed resources instead of active ones |

### `openvas_list_targets`

**List targets** · read-only
